title: Policy question, then asks for a person
why: General policy help needs no identity check, and an explicit request for a person is handed off without one. A common failure is an agent that says 'I can't help until you verify' to someone who only asked how refunds work.
turns: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
Ok. Honestly I'd rather talk to a real person about this. Can you put me through to someone?
